_about: Input side of the test set: what each synthetic voicemail SAYS and how it should SOUND. 'text' is written for the TTS engine (numbers as words, hard names spelled phonetically). The correct answers live in labels.json. Setting: Brightwater Plumbing & Heating, a small fictional UK business; the owner is called Sam. All phone numbers are from Ofcom's fictional ranges (07700 900xxx, 01632 960xxx).

_fields.speaker: Piper speaker id in en_GB-vctk-medium (0-108)
_fields.noise: background noise amplitude, 0 = clean, ~0.03 light, ~0.08 heavy
_fields.phone: true = squeeze into a narrow 8 kHz phone band like a real voicemail
_fields.format: output file extension, to make sure the pipeline handles any format
